assets.title: Suspended Basket Dye Vat
assets.description: One original fixed empty textile dye-vat visual form. A long chamfer-corner thick deep outer shell has a complete bottom and rests on a closed low support frame and four short full flat feet. One independently editable thick basket has all four perforated walls, ten real floor holes, twenty-eight true wall windows, a continuous top rim and two integral outward end ears. The ears rest on the full finite end shoulders of the outer rim; the entire basket bottom and all four sides have positive space from the outer shell. Two complete closed thick lifting rings have full finite roots on the basket rim. Nine closed connected editable meshes and five opaque unlinked constant PBR materials. Metres, native Z up, front -Y and horizontally bounds-centred four-foot ground datum. All shape geometry newly dimensioned: no old sieve copied into a shell, recoloured laundry basin, modified pet-wash grate or extractor with its spindle removed. One static empty prop, no liquid plane, cloth, dye, flame, extra container, texture, text, logo or animation. No take-out/lift path, dyeing, filtering, drainage, chemical/material compatibility, heating, capacity/loading, hygiene, manufacture, human/process/equipment safety or old-asset compatibility claim.
